parameters.query:
WITH existing AS (
  SELECT d.id
  FROM invoice_extractions e
  JOIN documents d ON d.id = e.document_id
  WHERE e.supplier_name = $1::text AND e.invoice_number = $2::text
  LIMIT 1
),
new_doc AS (
  INSERT INTO documents (filename, document_type, status, extracted_text)
  SELECT $3::text, 'invoice', $4::text, $5::text
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM existing)
  RETURNING id
),
new_ext AS (
  INSERT INTO invoice_extractions
    (document_id, supplier_name, invoice_number, invoice_date, currency,
     subtotal, tax_amount, total_amount, extraction_data)
  SELECT id, $1::text, $2::text, $6::date, $7::text,
         $8::numeric, $9::numeric, $10::numeric, $11::jsonb
  FROM new_doc
  RETURNING document_id
)
SELECT
  (SELECT id FROM new_doc) AS document_id,
  NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM existing) AS inserted,
  (SELECT id FROM existing) AS existing_document_id;
